token.description: Opaque bearer token. Stored server-side only as a SHA-256 hash.

snippet.description: Excerpt from the first matching user/assistant message; null for a title-only match.

absorbedMessageCount.description: Messages absorbed by this compaction (uptoSeq minus the previous compaction's uptoSeq, or uptoSeq itself for the first one).

beforeTokens.description: The summarization call's input token count.

afterTokens.description: The summarization call's output (summary) token count.

effort.description: The effort this compaction call ran at — inherited from the run whose prompt prefix it reuses, so its cached prefix stays valid. Absent when that run carried none.

uptoSeq.description: Messages with seq <= this were summarized for model context.

modelId.description: Opaque llame model id selected for this turn.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this turn. Must be one of the selected model's `reasoning.effortLevels[].value`; omit to use its `defaultEffort`. Matched byte-exactly — not case-folded.

visibility.description: Sharing: 'public' exposes a read-only link at /shared/:id; 'private' revokes it.

projectId.description: File the chat into this project. Pass null to unfile; omit to leave unchanged.

archived.description: Archive (true) or unarchive (false) the chat. Omit to leave unchanged.

fromMessageId.description: Copy up to (and including) this message. Omit to fork the whole conversation.

value.description: Opaque provider-native effort token. Matched byte-exactly on chat send; never a display string.

label.description: Operator-authored display label. Absent when the config used a bare string. Never invented from `value`.

effortLevels.description: Effort levels this model accepts, in the order a client presents them. Each item has a `value` (opaque provider-native identifier) and an optional operator `label`. Derive no meaning or magnitude from either string, and do not assume a value means the same thing on another model. Order is the only scale.

defaultEffort.description: The level value applied when a chat send omits `effort`. Always one of `effortLevels[].value`.

cacheInvalidatedByEffortChange.description: Whether CHANGING effort between turns invalidates this model's provider-side prompt cache — not whether effort does. Operator-declared, because the behavior is model-specific and partly undocumented. Advisory metadata for warning a user before a costly prefix re-read; it does not affect execution.

reasoning.description: Present only when the operator declared an effort vocabulary for this model. Absent means the model accepts no `effort` on a chat send.

preferredName.description: What the assistant should call you. Null clears it.

about.description: Role, work context, and languages, as prose. Null clears it. Counts against every request for you, so a maxed-out value is a material share of a small model context window.

responsePreferences.description: How answers should be delivered. Null clears it. These are delivery preferences of bounded authority: they cannot grant tools, relax tool authorization, or override safety constraints.

enabled.description: Master switch over all per-user prompt context. Turning it off also stops account identity, not just authored text.

shareAccountIdentity.description: Send your account display name and email address to the model provider the operator has configured — which in a multi-user instance may be a third party with no relationship to you. Defaults to false, and applies only where the configured prompt references those values.

effort.description: Reasoning effort this run executed at, resolved when the run was accepted. Absent when the run carried none. An opaque provider token — a receipt of what ran, never recomputed from current configuration.

modelId.description: Public llame model id selected for this run.

effort.description: Reasoning effort this run executed at, resolved when the run was accepted. Absent when the run carried none. An opaque provider token — a receipt of what ran, never recomputed from current configuration.

systemPrompt.description: Complete effective system prompt bound to this run.

shareRecentChats.description: Share titles and opening excerpts from your other chats with the model provider configured by the operator, which on a multi-user instance may be a third party with no relationship to you. Enabling is retroactive over your whole existing corpus, including chats and opening excerpts created long before opt-in. Disabling is not retroactive: it stops new baselines, re-bakes, and appends, but chats with an existing baseline keep sending it. Deleting a chat is not erasure: its title and excerpt survive in other chats' already-bound prompts, persisted appends, and receipts already issued. Defaults to false.

archived.description: Archive (true) or unarchive (false) the project. Omit to leave unchanged.

memberCount.description: Number of membership rows directly on this unit (org-memberships read enrichment, D3). Scoped by the same visibility as the roster: a unit visible only via the creator-bootstrap edge may transiently read 0.

directRole.description: The caller's own DIRECT role on this unit (not inherited from an ancestor); null when they hold no direct membership here. Inherited role is derivable client-side from the path.

settings.description: Opaque node-scoped settings (SPEC §7.2); replaces the whole object. Interpretation is the config resolver’s job (#46).

parentId.description: Move under this parent id. Explicit null promotes the unit to root. Omit to leave the unit where it is.

inherited.description: True when the role comes from an ancestor, not the unit itself.

modelId.description: Opaque llame model id selected for this turn.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this turn. Must be one of the selected model's `reasoning.effortLevels[].value`; omit to use its `defaultEffort`. Matched byte-exactly — not case-folded.

data.description: Bounded native observation from the existing canonical operation, including its evidence, notice and coverage. Not identical search scoring or source formatting.
